name: AP-automation lane
event_description: vendor invoices reaching approved status in the period

nodes.description: ERP / AP subledger emitting approved-invoice events
invoice approval routing tool recording who approved what, and when
banking / payment rails executing vendor payments
vendor master records, including remit-to bank details
enters vendor invoices into the ERP
approves routed invoices in the approval workflow

edges.trigger: approval written back; invoice becomes an approved-invoice event
vendor identity and remit-to details furnished for invoice and payment

control_points.statement_template: every approved invoice in {system} carries an approval captured in the approval workflow

assertions.description_template: an approval event exists in the approval workflow for each approved invoice in {system}

control_points.statement_template: every approved invoice in {system} was paid only after its approval and within the payment window

assertions.description_template: for each approved invoice in {system}, the approval event precedes the corresponding payment execution (payment leg is prose-only; see docs/lane-fit-notes.md FIT-002)
payment was executed within 10 business days of the {system} approval

control_points.statement_template: every approved invoice in {system} names a vendor with an active vendor-master record

assertions.description_template: the vendor on each approved invoice in {system} exists as an active record in the vendor master

control_points.statement_template: approval rights in {system} are held only by identities on the authorized approver roster

assertions.description_template: no identity outside the authorized approver roster appears among {system} access holders

control_points.statement_template: payment-release rights in {system} are held only by authorized treasury identities, none of whom enter invoices

assertions.description_template: no identity outside the authorized payment-release roster, and no invoice-entry identity, appears among {system} access holders

control_points.statement_template: vendor bank-detail edit rights in {system} are held only by authorized vendor-data identities

assertions.description_template: no identity outside the authorized vendor-data roster appears among {system} access holders
